title: Saul Meets Jesus
summary: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Acts 9:1-19 and look for how this passage teaches: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.

tell_it: Saul was going to hurt believers, but Jesus stopped him on the road. Saul became a servant of Jesus.
understand_it: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Saul Meets Jesus reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Grace matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Saul Meets Jesus shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
teen_explanation: Saul Meets Jesus gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
God sends His people to share good news.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when grace is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who met Saul on the road?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Jesus. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Acts 9:5 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Saul Meets Jesus?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Changed Direction
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Saul Meets Jesus. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
